canonical.name: The page follows the Hahn-decomposition exhaustion proof route for Radon-Nikodym and keeps the Hilbert-space proof only as an orientation remark.
The notation dnu/dmu denotes a mu-almost-everywhere equivalence class, so every derivative identity on the page is an almost-everywhere identity.
The already-published Cantor-measure witness for an atomless singular Borel measure on R is cited rather than duplicated in this batch.

contents.name: Exercise 13.11, the Radon-Nikodym derivative can depend on the sigma-algebra
contents.reason: This is a real phenomenon, but the page's local uniqueness convention is only almost-everywhere uniqueness for a fixed measurable structure. Changing the ambient sigma-algebra belongs with conditional expectation and versions, not this scalar page.
